title: Prayer Times
subtitle: Prayer & fasting timetable
error.network: Could not reach the prayer-time service. Check your connection and try Refresh.
error.offline: No cached timetable for this location and date. Configure your location, then Refresh.
error.settings: Some calculation settings are invalid. Review Settings and apply again.
error.location: Enter both a city and a country in Settings.
error.coordinates: Enter valid latitude (−90 to 90) and longitude (−180 to 180).
error.response: The service returned an invalid timetable. Please try Refresh later.
error.solar: Solar events are unavailable here. Consult your local prayer authority.
error.save: Settings could not be saved. Please try again.
solarWarning: Some dawn or solar events cannot be established at this latitude. Unavailable times are shown as —. Follow your local prayer authority; do not use these gaps as fasting boundaries.
windowWarning: Some end boundaries are unavailable or conflict with the selected convention or offsets. Review Settings and consult your local prayer authority.
unavailable: Times unavailable — open Settings or Refresh.
cached: Cached timetable · network unavailable or automatic fetching off
source:
AlAdhan calculations · not mosque congregation times
End boundaries follow your selected convention; confirm local guidance.
note: Sehri ends at Fajr, not sunrise. Avoid delaying Asr until near sunset. Check your local mosque's timetable, especially during Ramadan.
midnightNote: Isha end shown at the midpoint between sunset and next Fajr (half-night convention). Other rulings differ; follow your scholar.
fajrNote: Isha end shown at next Fajr (outer-limit convention), not a recommendation to delay it. Other rulings differ; follow your scholar.
coordinateHint: Use decimal degrees with a dot decimal separator. East/north are positive; west/south are negative. The timezone is resolved by the service.
ipHint: IP location is approximate and can be wrong with a VPN. Use a city or exact coordinates when accuracy matters.
manualHint: Enter city and country, then Save location.
networkNote: Network requests are off by default. Enabling automatic fetching checks every 15 minutes. Refresh makes an explicit request. IP mode contacts geo.omarchy.org; prayer calculations send your city or coordinates to api.aladhan.com over HTTPS. Timetables are cached locally.
